style: Graphic flat vector illustration in charcoal (#1c1c1c), crimson (#d62246) and white, bold road-sign shapes and arrows, urban boulevard feel, no text.
hero: A busy urban repair bay at dusk: a car on a lift, a crimson tool chest, road-arrow floor markings, city boulevard lights glowing faintly through a high window. Flat vector, DARK charcoal overall, crimson highlights. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people.
